name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Stacked questions that open one panel at a time, with a rotating chevron and orange open state.
usage:
<Accordion type="single" collapsible>
  <AccordionItem value="a">
    <AccordionTrigger>What is Lantern?</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>A small web for Minecraft servers.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
